bullets.title: Iran-US Hormuz Draft Framework Sparks >5% Crude Selloff
bullets.body: Multiple sources report Iran's state TV released a draft informal MOU framework with the US including US military withdrawal from areas near Iran, lifting of the naval blockade, and a commitment to restore commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz to pre-war levels within one month (military vessels excluded). Iran and Oman would jointly manage Hormuz traffic. Brent crude fell more than 5% on the headlines, with futures slipping below $95/barrel.

bullets.title: Micron Market Cap Surpasses Berkshire Hathaway After 6-9% Surge
bullets.body: Micron was up ~9% pre-market and ~6% intraday, pushing its market cap above Berkshire Hathaway's. One commentator noted both SK Hynix (newly in the $1T club) and Micron now exceed Berkshire in market cap, while contextualizing that current LTAs provide a structural pricing floor unlike prior memory cycles—suggesting the MU surge may not signal a broad DRAM upswing.

bullets.title: S&P Futures at Daily Record High; Goldman Flags Pension Selling Risk
bullets.body: S&P futures hit a daily record high, attributed broadly to memory-chip strength and easing geopolitical risk ('RAM and world peace'). Goldman separately warns that weakening liquidity combined with a looming mega-IPO pipeline could intensify month-end pension selling pressure.

bullets.title: Robinhood Launches AI Agent Trading and Spending Delegation Feature
bullets.body: Robinhood is rolling out a feature allowing customers to delegate both investing decisions and credit-card spending to AI agents, with support for tools including Anthropic's Claude and Cursor connected to dedicated accounts.

bullets.title: LITE, COHR, AAOI See Increased Analyst Coverage
bullets.body: A fintwit account flagged increased analyst coverage for optical/photonics names LITE, COHR, and AAOI, noting the coverage pickup was 'a little late to the story' but welcomed.

bullets.title: SK Hynix Joins $1T Club; Korean Stocks Echo Nasdaq 1999 Meltup
bullets.body: SK Hynix has crossed a $1 trillion market cap, and commentators are drawing comparisons between current Korean equity momentum and the Nasdaq meltup of 1999, raising questions about valuation sustainability in the memory sector.

bullets.title: BoE Rate Hike Bets Pared; Single 25bp Hike Now Consensus
bullets.body: Traders are reducing bets on multiple Bank of England rate increases, with market consensus now coalescing around a single 25bp hike this year, reflecting a shifting economic outlook.

bullets.title: China Slow-Walking Airbus Deliveries in Regulatory Tit-for-Tat
bullets.body: China is deliberately delaying approval of Airbus plane deliveries to signal impatience with European regulatory timelines for certifying Chinese aircraft—a tit-for-tat escalation between China and Europe.
